86:2: What has made you know what al-Tariq is?
86:4: There is no soul but over it is a watcher.
86:5: Let man look at what he was created from.
86:6: He was created from a gushing water.
86:7: It comes out from between the sulb and the tara'ib.
86:8: Indeed, He is certainly able to return him.
86:9: On that day secrets are tested.
86:10: For him there is neither a power nor a helper.
86:11: By the sky, possessor of return.
86:12: By the earth, possessor of the crack.
86:13: Indeed, it is certainly a decisive word.
86:15: Indeed, they are plotting a plot.
86:17: So give respite to the disbelievers, grant them a little time.
